purpose: PR #37 repeated before/after implementation comparison; not an engine promotion claim
authorization: User requested the comparison and merge readiness on 2026-09-11.
primordia_before: Frozen main legacy implementation and its historical training caps.

analysis.all_system_reporting: Report every system by benchmark, budget, seed and revision, including runtime, failures and baseline outcomes.

interpretation: Three seeds support descriptive repeats; no significance or broad superiority claim is pre-authorized.

The before/after intervention includes search, training and representation changes plus versioned host identity. The existing statistical gate must retain those protocol-drift blockers; do not normalize them away.
Same proposal budgets and configured epoch/wall-clock envelopes do not imply equal consumed compute. Report actual training and invocation runtime separately.
This is source-bound implementation qualification. Separate mechanism ablations and matched-compute scientific confirmation remain required by the plan.
Protected test data remains unused. Validation-selected winners are not protected-test results.
Concurrent host load is retained as a timing limitation. No other project is paused or modified.

execution.producer_checkouts: Separate clean full clones pinned to the declared revisions with locked dependencies.
execution.order: Campaign slot order is budget, seed, system. Execute each corresponding before/after pair consecutively; reverse the arm order on alternating slots.
execution.bounds: One fit worker at a time; each campaign invocation <=1800 seconds and at most one new run. No installed scheduler.
execution.resume: Use committed campaign journals. Never replace completed runs or silently drop an engine.
execution.failures: Preserve every failed attempt and mark the comparison incomplete. Runtime fixes require a new frozen full comparison; no selective successful-only report.

merge_acceptance: All 60 runs and 5760 fits complete without unresolved failures; all exports L3 and all 192 native winners replay.
Append registry rows without editing historical evidence; publish checksummed registry and full dependencies for both hosted lanes.
Review the five named dashboard slices and actual outcome/runtime tradeoffs; report the recomputed decision category and all blockers.
Pass the PR evidence gate and all required hosted checks on the reviewed head. No automatic scientific promotion.
